data.raw_text:
FIRE HITS RESIDENTIAL AREA ALONG NIA ROAD

A residential area along NIA Road in Barangay Pinyahan, Quezon City, was gutted by fire on Friday night, March 6.

The fire reached Task Force Bravo, destroying the homes of and displacing 3,500 families, according to barangay officials.

The Philippines observes Fire Prevention Month every March. Photos by Jire Carreon/Rappler
